title: Hytale client rejects generated Atmosphere volume animations
summary: After Atmosphere Tool 1.3.2 successfully entered the affected world, the Hytale 0.7.0 client logged repeated NullReferenceException warnings and failed to parse generated VFX/Atmosphere/Volume blockyanim assets. Thirty warnings covered nineteen distinct animation paths. No disconnect occurred; rendering impact was not assessed.
problem_class: server-valid generated animation rejected by client parser
problem_description: Runtime-generated fog blockyanim files pass server parsing and replication tests but trigger client NullReferenceException and parse warnings after world join.
context: The error became visible after removing the earlier WorldLoadProgress disconnect. The affected-world log reached InGame and then reported failures under VFX/Atmosphere/Volume.
constraints: Do not infer rendering success from server parser tests
known_attempts: Server-side BlockyAnimationCache parsing and native replication probe passed, but did not predict client parser behavior
transferability: Generated Hytale animation assets require a real client parsing gate; server-side parsing and replication alone are insufficient evidence.

source_refs.description: Thirty failed animation parsing warnings for nineteen distinct generated Atmosphere volume paths after successful world join.
